patch_description: The current approach uses a single-pass Steiner-like discount (0.001) on used edges. The new algorithm: (1) makes reuse fully free (discount 0.0) so later destinations maximally prefer already-paid trunks, (2) adds an outer refinement loop (2 extra passes) where used_edges from the previous pass seed the next routing pass, letting the tree restructure toward cheaper shared trunks, and (3) evaluates both orderings (by base shortest-path cost and reverse) and keeps the pass producing the lowest total unique-edge cost.
